title: FBI Photo B9
what_is_it: A monochrome still image captured by a U.S. military sensor system, showing an unidentified circular object against a mountainous background.
redaction_evidence: heavy — original imagery was altered with redactions before submission, most HUD text is garbled or obscured, and no accompanying mission report was provided
interpretation_warnings: The source text is heavily garbled due to poor OCR quality on a grainy monochrome image — most HUD overlay text is unreadable.
The image was altered with redactions before submission, meaning potentially identifying details have been removed.
No mission report accompanied the image, so there is no operational context, flight data, or sensor parameters available.
The displayed date (12/31/39) is confirmed incorrect due to an unset system clock; the actual incident date is only described as 'late 2025'.
This is a single still image from a single source with no corroborating data or sensor fusion.
The narrative description provided by the releasing authority explicitly states it should not be interpreted as an analytical judgment or factual determination.

verifiable_claims.claim: The date displayed on the image is incorrect because the system clock was not set.
